ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the Cartesian coordinate system, let us consider a parabola $y=\frac{1}{2}x^{2}+bx+c$ (where $b$ and $c$ are constants). The vertex of the parabola is given by the coordinates $\left(\frac{3}{2}, -\frac{25}{8}\right)$. This parabola intersects the $x$-axis at points $A$ and $B$ (with $A$ located to the left of $B$) and intersects the $y$-axis at point $C$. Point $C$ and point $D$ are symmetric with respect to the $x$-axis. The line segment $AD$ is drawn, and so is the straight line $BD$. When point $P$ is on the parabola and point $Q$ is on the line $BD$, and the quadrilateral formed by points $C$, $D$, $P$, and $Q$ is a parallelogram, write down the coordinates of point $Q$ directly.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a parabola opening upward, intersecting the x-axis at the left point A and the right point B, and intersecting the negative half-axis of the y-axis at C; point D is on the positive half-axis of the y-axis and is the symmetric point of C with respect to the x-axis; line BD is a line slanting downward to the right, passing through D and B, and segment AD is also drawn. Solve by coordinate/vector algebra. Since the vertex is (3/2,-25/8), the parabola can be written as y=1/2(x-3/2)^2-25/8=1/2x^2-3/2x-2. Therefore C=(0,-2), D=(0,2). Let y=0, obtaining x^2-3x-4=0, that is, x=-1 or 4, therefore A=(-1,0), B=(4,0). Line BD passes through (0,2) and (4,0), and its equation is y=-x/2+2. Let Q lie on BD, Q=(t,-t/2+2). Consider the three diagonal pairings for C,D,P,Q to form a parallelogram. 1) C+P=D+Q, then P=Q+(0,4)=(t,-t/2+6). Substitute into the parabola: -t/2+6=1/2t^2-3/2t-2, simplifying gives t^2-2t-16=0, so t=1±sqrt(17). The corresponding Q are (1-sqrt(17),(3+sqrt(17))/2) and (1+sqrt(17),(3-sqrt(17))/2). 2) C+Q=D+P, then P=Q-(0,4)=(t,-t/2-2). Substitute into the parabola: -t/2-2=1/2t^2-3/2t-2, simplifying gives t(t-2)=0. When t=0, Q=D and P=C, degenerate, discard; when t=2, Q=(2,1). 3) C+D=P+Q, then P=-Q=(-t,t/2-2). Substitute into the parabola: t/2-2=1/2t^2+3/2t-2, simplifying gives t(t+2)=0. t=0 is degenerate, discard; when t=-2, Q=(-2,3).

按坐标/向量代数求解。由顶点为(3/2,-25/8)，抛物线可写为 y=1/2(x-3/2)^2-25/8=1/2x^2-3/2x-2。所以C=(0,-2)，D=(0,2)。令y=0，得x^2-3x-4=0，即x=-1或4，因此A=(-1,0)，B=(4,0)。直线BD过(0,2)和(4,0)，方程为y=-x/2+2。设Q在BD上，Q=(t,-t/2+2)。

method.method_draft: Use a locus-transformation approach. First obtain the exact objects from the text: the parabola is f(x)=1/2x^2-3/2x-2, C=(0,-2), D=(0,2), B=(4,0), and BD is y=-x/2+2. Let v=D-C=(0,4). Instead of solving for P directly, derive the possible loci of Q from the three parallelogram configurations. If CD and PQ are corresponding opposite sides, then Q is P shifted by -v, so Q lies on the translated parabola y=f(x)-4. If DQ and CP are corresponding opposite sides, then Q is P shifted by +v, so Q lies on y=f(x)+4. If C and D are opposite vertices, then P and Q are opposite vertices with midpoint the origin, so Q is the central reflection of P, giving the reflected locus y=-f(-x). Intersect each of these three loci with line BD, remove degenerate intersections where Q coincides with D or P coincides with C, and list the remaining Q-coordinates.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图是示意图，显示一条开口向上的抛物线，与 x 轴交于左侧点 A 和右侧点 B，与 y 轴交于下方点 C；点 D 在 y 轴上方，与 C 关于 x 轴对称；直线 BD 是一条向右下方倾斜的直线。这与题干给出的几何关系一致。推理：由顶点为 (3/2, -25/8) 且二次项系数为 1/2，可得抛物线 f(x)=1/2(x-3/2)^2-25/8=1/2x^2-3/2x-2。因此 C=(0,-2)，D=(0,2)。令 f(x)=0，得 x^2-3x-4=0，所以 A=(-1,0)，B=(4,0)。直线 BD 过 D=(0,2), B=(4,0)，故方程为 y=-x/2+2。设 v=D-C=(0,4)。按指定的轨迹变换方法，考虑三种平行四边形配置。第一种，CD 与 PQ 为对应对边，则 Q=P-v，所以 Q 在平移后的抛物线 y=f(x)-4=1/2x^2-3/2x-6 上。与 y=-x/2+2 联立，得 x^2-2x-16=0，故 x=1±sqrt(17)，对应 Q=(1-sqrt(17),(3+sqrt(17))/2) 与 Q=(1+sqrt(17),(3-sqrt(17))/2)。第二种，DQ 与 CP 为对应对边，则 Q=P+v，所以 Q 在 y=f(x)+4=1/2x^2-3/2x+2 上。与 y=-x/2+2 联立，得 x=0 或 x=2。x=0 时 Q=D 且退化，舍去；x=2 得 Q=(2,1)。第三种，C 与 D 为相对顶点，则它们的中点是原点，P 与 Q 也关于原点成中心对称，所以 Q 的轨迹为 y=-f(-x)=-1/2x^2-3/2x+2。与 y=-x/2+2 联立，得 x=0 或 x=-2。x=0 时退化，舍去；x=-2 得 Q=(-2,3)。

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：附图是示意图，显示一条开口向上的抛物线，与 x 轴交于左侧点 A 和右侧点 B，与 y 轴交于下方点 C；点 D 在 y 轴上方，与 C 关于 x 轴对称；直线 BD 是一条向右下方倾斜的直线。这与题干给出的几何关系一致。推理：由顶点为 (3/2, -25/8) 且二次项系数为 1/2，可得抛物线 f(x)=1/2(x-3/2)^2-25/8=1/2x^2-3/2x-2。因此 C=(0,-2)，D=(0,2)。令 f(x)=0，得 x^2-3x-4=0，所以 A=(-1,0)，B=(4,0)。直线 BD 过 D=(0,2), B=(4,0)，故方程为 y=-x/2+2。设 v=D-C=(0,4)。按指定的轨迹变换方法，考虑三种平行四边形配置。第一种，CD 与 PQ 为对应对边，则 Q=P-v，所以 Q 在平移后的抛物线 y=f(x)-4=1/2x^2-3/2x-6 上。与 y=-x/2+2 联立，得 x^2-2x-16=0，故 x=1±sqrt(17)，对应 Q=(1-sqrt(17),(3+sqrt(17))/2) 与 Q=(1+sqrt(17),(3-sqrt(17))/2)。第二种，DQ 与 CP 为对应对边，则 Q=P+v，所以 Q 在 y=f(x)+4=1/2x^2-3/2x+2 上。与 y=-x/2+2 联立，得 x=0 或 x=2。x=0 时 Q=D 且退化，舍去；x=2 得 Q=(2,1)。第三种，C 与 D 为相对顶点，则它们的中点是原点，P 与 Q 也关于原点成中心对称，所以 Q 的轨迹为 y=-f(-x)=-1/2x^2-3/2x+2。与 y=-x/2+2 联立，得 x=0 或 x=-2。x=0 时退化，舍去；x=-2 得 Q=(-2,3)。

raw_record.original_question: In the Cartesian coordinate system, consider the parabola $y=\frac{1}{2}x^{2}+bx+c$ (where $b$ and $c$ are constants). Its vertex is $\left(\frac{3}{2},-\frac{25}{8}\right)$. The parabola intersects the $x$-axis at points $A$ and $B$ (with $A$ to the left of $B$) and intersects the $y$-axis at point $C$. Point $D$ is symmetric to point $C$ with respect to the $x$-axis. Segment $AD$ and line $BD$ are drawn. If point $P$ is on the parabola and point $Q$ is on line $BD$, and quadrilateral $CDPQ$ is a parallelogram, write down the coordinates of point $Q$ directly.
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure there is a parabola opening upward, intersecting the x-axis at the left point A and the right point B, and intersecting the negative half-axis of the y-axis at C; point D is on the positive half-axis of the y-axis and is the symmetric point of C with respect to the x-axis; line BD is a line slanting downward to the right, passing through D and B, and segment AD is also drawn.

Solve by coordinate/vector algebra. Since the vertex is (3/2,-25/8), the parabola can be written as y=1/2(x-3/2)^2-25/8=1/2x^2-3/2x-2. Therefore C=(0,-2), D=(0,2). Let y=0, obtaining x^2-3x-4=0, that is, x=-1 or 4, therefore A=(-1,0), B=(4,0). Line BD passes through (0,2) and (4,0), and its equation is y=-x/2+2. Let Q lie on BD, Q=(t,-t/2+2).

Consider the three diagonal pairings for C,D,P,Q to form a parallelogram.
1) C+P=D+Q, then P=Q+(0,4)=(t,-t/2+6). Substitute into the parabola: -t/2+6=1/2t^2-3/2t-2, simplifying gives t^2-2t-16=0, so t=1±sqrt(17). The corresponding Q are (1-sqrt(17),(3+sqrt(17))/2) and (1+sqrt(17),(3-sqrt(17))/2).
2) C+Q=D+P, then P=Q-(0,4)=(t,-t/2-2). Substitute into the parabola: -t/2-2=1/2t^2-3/2t-2, simplifying gives t(t-2)=0. When t=0, Q=D and P=C, degenerate, discard; when t=2, Q=(2,1).
3) C+D=P+Q, then P=-Q=(-t,t/2-2). Substitute into the parabola: t/2-2=1/2t^2+3/2t-2, simplifying gives t(t+2)=0. t=0 is degenerate, discard; when t=-2, Q=(-2,3).
